Cognate with Swedish vissla (“to whistle”), Icelandic hvísla (“to whisper”), Russian свистеть (svistetʹ, “to whistle”).

senses.definition: to make a high sound or musical tune by forcing air through closed lips.

examples.en: She cheerfully whistled a tune as she cleaned the house.
examples.vi: Cô ấy vui vẻ huýt sáo một giai điệu khi dọn dẹp nhà cửa.

examples.en: The man whistled loudly to get the waiter's attention.
examples.vi: Người đàn ông huýt sáo lớn để thu hút sự chú ý của người phục vụ.

senses.definition: to produce a shrill, loud sound from a pipe, engine, or kettle.

examples.en: The tea kettle whistled when the water reached boiling point.
examples.vi: Chiếc ấm trà reo lên khi nước sôi.

senses.vi: thổi còi; hú còi; kêu réo

senses.definition: to travel rapidly through the air, creating a sharp whistling noise.

examples.en: The cold wind whistled through the narrow mountain pass.
examples.vi: Cơn gió lạnh rít qua con đèo núi hẹp.

wiktionary.gloss: To make a shrill, high-pitched sound by forcing air through the mouth. To produce a whistling sound, restrictions to the flow of air are created using the teeth, tongue and lips.

examples: The steam train whistled as it passed by.
wiktionary.gloss: To make a similar sound by forcing air through a musical instrument or a pipe etc.

examples: A bullet whistled past.

blocks.etymology: From xero- + ophthalmia.

thesaurus.definition: abnormal dryness of the conjunctiva and cornea of the eyes; may be due to a systemic deficiency of vitamin A

translations.words: chứng khô mắt; bệnh khô mắt

wiktionary.gloss: A condition due to a deficiency of vitamin A where the conjunctiva and cornea become dry. The condition starts with conjunctival xerosis and night blindness and progresses to corneal xerosis and, later, a severe condition called keratomalacia.
